text: dsh-team-model 为 DSH Agent Teams 提供按队友选择模型的能力。它注册 spawn_teammate_with_model 工具，并在 Web 会话头部、输入框工具行和设置页加入模型切换入口。用户可以为单个队友选择模型和推理强度，也可以批量设置整队；模型路由会持续应用，队友离线时可排队到下次启动。适合需要让不同队友使用不同模型的 DSH 团队工作流。

dsh-team-model adds model selection per teammate to DSH Agent Teams. It registers a model-aware spawn tool and adds controls in the session header, composer, and settings. Users can choose a model for one teammate or a whole team. Selections persist across requests; offline changes apply at restart.
我想让不同的 Agent Team 队友用不同模型处理任务。
创建子代理时，能不能直接指定它使用的模型？
希望在 DSH 会话界面里切换某个队友的模型。
队友模型切换后下一轮又变回去了，怎么让选择持续生效？
能不能给离线队友预先设置模型，等它启动后再应用？
I want to change a teammate’s model from the session header or composer.
How can I keep a selected model applied to a teammate across later turns?
Can I choose one model for every teammate in a team at once?
dsh-team-model 的功能「按模型创建队友」：Lead 可调用 spawn_teammate_with_model 创建队友，并传入 provider、model 和 reasoning_effort；不指定模型时沿用当前会话。
dsh-team-model 的功能「持续应用队友模型」：队友每次请求都会读取会话模型投影并覆盖路由，让所选模型在后续轮次继续生效。
dsh-team-model 的功能「界面切换单个模型」：用户可从会话头部或输入框工具行打开菜单，为一个队友挑选模型与可用的推理强度。
dsh-team-model 的功能「批量设置队友模型」：设置页按 Lead 会话列出团队，可单独修改成员，也能一次为整队应用同一模型。
dsh-team-model 的功能「离线队友模型排队」：为当前不在线的队友选择模型后，插件保存待应用路由，并在该 Agent 下次创建时写入会话。

dsh-team-model README · dsh-team-model：中文 · [English](README.en.md)

> 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 Agent Teams 补上「按队友指定模型」：模型可以自己指定，用户也可以在 Web UI 里随时修改。

内置团队插件 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team` 在创建队友时不接受模型参数——`spawn_teammate` 只有 `name / description / prompt / context`，两个本地 subagent provider 也只认 `providerName`，因此所有队友都继承 Lead 当前的路由。

这个插件补上这一层，并且只使用框架的公开接口：新增一个工具、向子会话写入一条既有的 `model/selection` 事件、在 `agent/request` 中保持路由，再用一条 loopback RPC 支撑 Web UI。

dsh-team-model README · 1. 模型可以自己指定队友的模型：新增工具 `spawn_teammate_with_model`，参数与内置 `spawn_teammate` 一致，另有三项可选：

```jsonc
{
  "name": "reviewer",              // 必填，[a-z0-9-]，≤64 字符
  "description": "代码审查",       // 必填
  "prompt": "审查这次改动…",        // 必填

模型会在队友的首轮请求之前写入子会话，因此第一次回复就使用新路由，不会先用继承的模型跑一轮。
section: 1. 模型可以自己指定队友的模型

text:
dsh-team-model README · 2. 用户可以在三处切换：| 入口 | slot | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 会话头部胶囊 | `conversation.session.header.actions` | 列出本队队友，点开选模型 |
| 输入框工具行 | `conversation.input.right` | 窄屏自动收成图标 + 模型名 |
| 设置 → 队友模型 | `settings.section` | 按会话分组，单个修改或整队统一，含离线队友 |

在队友会话里打开时会自动聚焦该队友（标题显示「模型」），只修改它自己的模型，不再列出整支团队。

dsh-team-model README · 3. 切换后一直有效：内置的模型选择是一次性的：`selectionFor(agent).current` 被一次请求消费后就清空，下一次请求回退到会话头或默认模型——表现为「切换只生效一轮」。插件在**队友** agent 上挂 `agent/request` waterfall，按会话投影 `modelSelection.pending ?? lastUsed` 覆写 provider/model/reasoningEffort，因此第二轮、第三轮仍然是你选的那个模型，直到你再次修改。
dsh-team-model README · 4. 离线队友也能排队：不在线的队友没有运行中的 Agent，选择会进入队列（`queued`），在它下次启动时、第一条请求之前写入；界面会提示「该队友当前不在线，模型已记下，下次启动时生效」。

dsh-team-model README · 安装：插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle（`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + host/client 两个入口）。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Chruix/dsh-team-model ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-team-model
```

然后在 DSH 的插件管理器里安装该目录（`install_bundle`），或在 profile 中插入一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: team-model
      name: dsh-team-model
```

依赖的 Host 服务：`agents / agentTeams / tools / systemPrompt / sessionController / llm / connection / webServer`。缺少任一项时，该 profile 不会激活本插件。

dsh-team-model README · 架构：```
index.js   Host 半边（Cordis 插件）
  ├─ spawn_teammate_with_model   新增工具，只注册到 Lead 的 agent.ctx
  ├─ applySelection / applyOrQueue
  │    ctx.sessionController.agents.selectForNextRequest(agent, selection)

**为什么 RPC 不走 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle`？** 在 0.2.1-rc.5 中，它把注册落在 connection 服务自己的 ctx 上，而那个 ctx 读不到 `webServer`，第三方插件调用时必然抛出 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`（在客户端表现为 HTTP 405）。`ctx.get('webServer')` 可以绕过注入守卫拿到服务，因此插件自行实现 RPC 信封：

dsh-team-model README · 配置：```yaml
- id: team-model
  name: dsh-team-model
  config:
    defaultModel: ""        # 未显式指定时的默认队友模型（provider/model 或裸 model id）

dsh-team-model README · 安全边界：插件的 RPC 只监听宿主自己的回环地址，并在处理请求前逐项检查：

- `Host` 必须是回环地址（`127.0.0.0/8`、`localhost`、`[::1]` 及其 IPv4 映射形式）；
- 带了 `Origin` 就必须是回环来源；`Sec-Fetch-Site` 必须是 `same-origin` 或 `none`；
- `Content-Type` 必须是 `application/json`，body 上限 64 KiB，超过直接 413；
- `rpcId` 必须是 1–128 字符的字符串。

插件不读凭据、不写会话以外的存储；所有模型改动都以 `model/selection` 事件写进对应会话的日志，和 `/model` 用的是同一条链路。

dsh-team-model README · 已知限制：- 团队按会话隔离：Lead 只能管理自己会话中的队友，因此「全局设置」的实现方式是遍历所有在线 Lead。
- 一个会话只有一支 team，成员数受内置团队插件的 `maxMembers` 限制（插件默认 16，本机 profile 配的是 8），
  且没有移除队友的公开接口——满员后只能复用已有队友。
- 推理强度由各模型分别声明：目录中 `reasoning.efforts` 为空的提供方（例如某些聚合网关）不显示强度入口，强行传入会被拒绝并返回可读的错误信息。
- UI 依赖前端 shell 提供的虚拟模块 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，无需在 `package.json` 中声明依赖。

dsh-team-model README · 开发：```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
```

修改代码后需要让 loader 重新 import：

```
remove_bundle dsh-team-model
install_bundle /path/to/dsh-team-model
```

回执中出现 `"application": "applied"` 才算生效（对已安装的包，`install_bundle` 只会返回 `already-installed`）。仓库中的 `test/` 包含三套 Node 冒烟测试：渲染（fake React/primitives）、RPC 与批量端点。

dsh-team-model README · 开发：```bash
node test/client-smoke.cjs                       # 无需运行中的宿主
DSH_RPC_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:43189/dsh-team-model \
  DSH_LEAD_SESSION=<lead id> DSH_CHILD_SESSION=<child id> \
  node test/rpc.cjs

dsh-team-model README · dsh-team-model：[中文](README.md) · English

> Adds per-teammate model selection to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Agent Teams: the model can pick a teammate's model itself, and you can change it at any time from the Web UI.

dsh-team-model README · dsh-team-model：The stock team plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`) accepts no model parameter when it creates a teammate — `spawn_teammate` only takes `name / description / prompt / context`, and both local subagent providers only understand `providerName`. Every teammate therefore inherits the Lead's current route.

dsh-team-model README · dsh-team-model：This plugin closes that gap and uses nothing but public framework surfaces: one new tool, one existing `model/selection` event written to the child session, route pinning inside `agent/request`, and a loopback RPC that backs the Web UI.

dsh-team-model README · 1. The model can assign a teammate's model：A new tool, `spawn_teammate_with_model`, takes the same arguments as the built-in `spawn_teammate` plus three optional ones:

```jsonc
{
  "name": "reviewer",              // required, [a-z0-9-], <= 64 chars
  "description": "Code review",    // required
  "prompt": "Review this change…", // required

The route is written into the child session *before* the teammate's first request, so the first reply already uses it instead of spending a turn on the inherited model.
section: 1. The model can assign a teammate's model

text:
dsh-team-model README · 2. Users can switch from three places：| Entry | Slot | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Session header pill | `conversation.session.header.actions` | Lists this team's teammates; pick a model from the popover |
| Composer tool row | `conversation.input.right` | Collapses to an icon + model name on narrow windows |
| Settings → Team models | `settings.section` | Grouped by session; per-teammate or whole-team; includes offline teammates |
section: 2. Users can switch from three places

text: dsh-team-model README · 2. Users can switch from three places：Opened inside a teammate's session it focuses that teammate automatically (the title becomes "Model") and only changes that teammate's model, without listing the rest of the team.
section: 2. Users can switch from three places

text: dsh-team-model README · 3. A switch keeps applying：The built-in model selection is one-shot: `selectionFor(agent).current` is consumed by a single request and cleared, so the next request falls back to the session header or the default model — the symptom is "the switch only survives one turn". The plugin attaches an `agent/request` waterfall to **teammate** agents and overrides provider/model/reasoningEffort from the session projection `modelSelection.pending ?? lastUsed`, so the second and third turns still use the model you picked, until you change it again.

dsh-team-model README · 4. Offline teammates are queued：An offline teammate has no live Agent, so the change is queued (`queued`) and written just before its next run starts. The UI says: "This teammate is offline; the model was recorded and will apply on the next start."

dsh-team-model README · Install：The plugin is a standard DSH bundle (`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` plus host and client entry points).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Chruix/dsh-team-model ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-team-model
```

Install that directory from the DSH plugin manager (`install_bundle`), or insert a row into your profile:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: team-model
      name: dsh-team-model
```

dsh-team-model README · Install：Required host services: `agents / agentTeams / tools / systemPrompt / sessionController / llm / connection / webServer`. If any of them is missing, the profile will not activate the plugin.

dsh-team-model README · Architecture：```
index.js   Host half (Cordis plugin)
  ├─ spawn_teammate_with_model   new tool, registered only on the Lead's agent.ctx
  ├─ applySelection / applyOrQueue
  │    ctx.sessionController.agents.selectForNextRequest(agent, selection)

dsh-team-model README · Architecture：**Why not `ctx.connection.rpc.handle` for the RPC?** In 0.2.1-rc.5 that API registers the route on the connection service's own context, which cannot read `webServer`, so third-party callers always hit `cannot get property "webServer" without inject` (surfacing as HTTP 405 on the client). `ctx.get('webServer')` retrieves the service past the inject guard, so the plugin speaks the wire format itself:

dsh-team-model README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: team-model
  name: dsh-team-model
  config:
    defaultModel: ""        # default teammate model when none is given (provider/model or bare model id)

dsh-team-model README · Security boundaries：The plugin never reads credentials and stores nothing outside the session logs; every model change is appended as a `model/selection` event to that session — the same path `/model` uses.

dsh-team-model README · Known limitations：- Teams are isolated per session: a Lead only manages its own session's teammates, so "global settings" means iterating over every live Lead.
- Each session owns exactly one team, and its size is capped by the stock team plugin's `maxMembers`
  (the plugin default is 16; this profile configures 8). There is no public way to remove a teammate,
  so once the team is full you can only reuse the members you have.
- Reasoning effort is declared per model: providers whose catalog entries carry an empty `reasoning.efforts` (some aggregator gateways, for example) show no effort selector, and forcing one is rejected with a readable error instead of being silently dropped.
- The UI depends on the virtual module `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` provided by the web shell; it must not be declared as a dependency in `package.json`.

dsh-team-model README · Development：```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
```

After changing code, make the loader import it again:

```
remove_bundle dsh-team-model
install_bundle /path/to/dsh-team-model
```

Only `"application": "applied"` in the reply means it took effect (`install_bundle` answers `already-installed` for an installed package). The `test/` directory holds three Node smoke suites: rendering (fake React/primitives), RPC, and the batch endpoints.

dsh-team-model README · Development：```bash
node test/client-smoke.cjs                       # no running host required
DSH_RPC_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:43189/dsh-team-model \
  DSH_LEAD_SESSION=<lead id> DSH_CHILD_SESSION=<child id> \
  node test/rpc.cjs
